commit: The work commit carrying this report; its hash is recorded by the Runner in PROJECT_STATUS-PHASE-2.5.md because a report cannot contain its own hash.
summary: Baseline of HEAD 615be51 before any Phase 2.5 domain work, run in a clean git worktree with npm ci so the user's uncommitted .gitignore change and their running server on port 3111 were untouched. The first full pass was not green and is recorded as such: 1 database failure and 7 browser failures plus 1 skip. Each was classified with evidence. The database failure was drift from post-handoff commit 5b3ed72, which added imageFileId and imageAltFa to the public breed list row without updating tests/db/breeds.test.ts; the expectation now pins both fields. The 6 communities failures were a Chromium renderer crash (Target crashed) in the before hook and the kennel failure a 30 s stability wait, both under 2.2-2.4 GB free memory, and both suites passed when run alone. The always-skipped content-image 304 test was deterministic: a11y sorts before content and the harness seeds no content, so its assertions moved into content.test.ts right after the article that really has an image. The Phase 2 intermittent content-image upload failure reproduced, and the diagnostic added in Phase 2 named it: an optimistic-lock conflict. The save banner arrives from the action before the revalidated page gives the other editor forms the new expectedVersion, so the test uploaded with the old version and the server correctly refused. The test now waits for every expectedVersion input to change after a successful versioned save; no timeout was widened and no assertion removed. After the fixes the full browser matrix passed 161/161 with no skip. The baseline, audit (no CI, 6 npm audit findings, 31 migrations without per-migration rollback notes, in-memory search, unset integrations, missing field a11y/CWV evidence, 80 abandoned test databases) and report drift are in docs/qa/phase-2.5-baseline.md. The Runner gained a phase 2.5 entry that reads the untracked package in place.

Includes release.test.ts (every sitemap address answers 200, none guarded) and privacy.test.ts (anonymous, non-owner and malformed private file requests refused).

The content version race is fixed by root cause; three isolated green repeats and one full green run are evidence, not proof, for a timing race.
